summary: Diff adds a full clean-boot reset utility, two emergency reset entry points (/reset route and /login?reset=1), safe return-path validation, and improves ProtectedRoute with visible loading/redirect UI. However, the diff evidence is insufficient to confirm the required post-login redirect fixes for both OTP and Internet Identity flows, and only partially shows dashboard crash/error-handling changes due to truncation. Several unrelated premium UI/theme/background and product UI changes appear outside the requested scope.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix post-login redirect behavior so successful login (OTP and Internet Identity) navigates to /dashboard (or a stored safe return path) consistently; clear return path after navigation; hard refresh after login should not blank screen.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows return-path safety utilities and ProtectedRoute storing a safe return path, but does not show the actual success handlers for OTP verification or Internet Identity login being updated to navigate to /dashboard / safe return path and then clear it. LoginPage and DashboardPage are truncated before any successful login navigation logic is visible.
evidence: frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx (truncated; only shows reset param handling and imports getSafeReturnPath)
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx (truncated; shows getReturnPath/clearReturnPath imported/used but not the navigation flow)

missing_requirements.requirement: Resolve dashboard first-load crash: /dashboard must render safely during auth restoration and when backend/query dependencies aren’t ready; show visible loading/fallback; show visible error state with recovery action; ProtectedRoute must not silently null-render.
missing_requirements.reason: ProtectedRoute is updated to show visible loading and redirecting UI, but the DashboardPage changes required for safe rendering/loading/error recovery are not fully verifiable from the truncated content. While ordersError/ordersLoading variables appear, the diff summary does not show a dedicated visible error UI with recovery actions (retry/go to login/reset) or an explicit non-blank fallback for all critical dependencies on first load.
evidence: frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx (truncated; shows ordersLoading/ordersError variables but not the rendered fallback/error UI)

hallucinated_features.description: Large set of premium/luxury UI updates (header/footer redesign, product card visual overhaul, background animation changes, Tailwind theme/animation additions) unrelated to the reset/auth blank-screen requirements.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on clean-boot reset, emergency reset entry points, redirect reliability, and dashboard safe rendering. The diff summary indicates substantial unrelated visual/UX changes across many components.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (Header.tsx, Footer.tsx, ProductCard.tsx, OceanBackground.tsx, SangamBackground.tsx, index.css, tailwind.config.js, ProductsPage.tsx)

hallucinated_features.description: Release notes update claiming broader Phase 4 acceptance criteria confirmation unrelated to the requested fixes.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request updating RELEASE_NOTES.md or documenting unrelated phases; the diff summary includes a release notes modification.
